name: Messenger to Westfall
summary: A letter from Westfall brings Magistrate Solomon a hard answer in Lakeshire. He asked Gryan Stoutmantle for soldiers to defend Redridge, but Westfall has been left to face its own troubles.

sections.title: A Plea Across Shifting Frontiers
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon faces growing troubles in the Redridge Mountains without Stormwind's royal garrison. He looks to the southern frontier for help and writes to Gryan Stoutmantle, commander of the People's Militia in Westfall. Solomon hopes the volunteers at Sentinel Hill can spare fighters to strengthen Lakeshire's defenses. He does not know how hard pressed the western plains are.

sections.title: A Bitter Refusal
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle refuses, though the answer weighs heavily on him. Westfall is fighting the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls because the House of Nobles and the crown have abandoned the kingdom's breadbasket. The People's Militia formed so the people could survive. Its ranks lose good men each day, and Stoutmantle cannot spare a single fighter for Redridge.

sections.title: The Kingdom's Fracturing Realm
sections.body: When you carry Stoutmantle's reply back to Lakeshire, Solomon sees that the frontier territories share the same neglect. Local magistrates and citizen militias are left to defend themselves while the Stormwind Army remains withheld. Solomon turns his attention south, toward Darkshire in Duskwood, hoping to find aid there.

faq.q: Why did Magistrate Solomon ask Westfall for help?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon sought help because Lakeshire faces growing threats without Stormwind's army. He knew Gryan Stoutmantle had organized the People's Militia to defend Westfall and hoped it could spare soldiers for Redridge.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle refuse to send aid?
faq.answer: Westfall is already fighting the Defias Brotherhood and defending itself from marauding gnolls. Stoutmantle says the Militia exists because Stormwind abandoned Westfall, and it has no fighters to spare.

faq.q: Where is the Stormwind Army during these crises?
faq.answer: No one in the letters knows why the Stormwind Army is away. Solomon and Stoutmantle can only wonder what keeps it from defending the outer provinces.

faq.q: What happens after returning Stoutmantle's letter to Solomon?
aliases: next quest after messenger to westfall
faq.answer: After learning Westfall cannot help, Magistrate Solomon turns to Duskwood. He sends you on to Darkshire, hoping Mayor Ello Ebonlocke's Night Watch can offer aid.

The People's Militia is a volunteer force organized by Gryan Stoutmantle and based at Sentinel Hill. Local farmers, veterans, and residents defend Westfall from outlaws and gnolls without crown troops.
Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran soldier who leads Westfall's defense. From the tower at Sentinel Hill, he gathers volunteers and directs the fight against the Defias Brotherhood.

angles.text: This correspondence shows the divide between Stormwind Keep's rulers and the outlying provinces. Westfall and Redridge are left to fend for themselves.
As a human traveler, you see how isolated the provincial towns are. Commoners and veterans bleed to defend lands the nobles of Stormwind refuse to protect.
